result.question: What plan did 40 men present to priests?

readings.answer: That the Sanhedrin should ask the commander to bring Paul for a supposed careful examination so they could kill him on the way.
readings.support: you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.

readings.answer: To kill Paul, having bound themselves by an oath not to eat until they did.
readings.support: We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.

assessments.reason: It states the Sanhedrin should summon Paul on a pretext and “We are ready to kill him on the way,” which matches killing Paul before he reaches the council.
It captures the core plan—kill Paul under an oath—based on “We have bound ourselves… until we have killed Paul,” though it omits the specific ambush-before-the-council detail.
